question_text: Write the summary of the passage in not more than
guide_solution: Summary. Greenhouse effect is an alarming fact for our environment at present time. a lots of fossil fuels. such as mineral oil, natural gas, coal, etc. are burnt daily to produce energy for factories, different types of vehicles and our houses, the production of carbon dioxide is increasing day by day. The rapid imprecise of carbon dioxide, thus, cause Greenhouse effect. Cutting down threes indiscriminately is also responsible for that though trees help us survive absorbing carbon dioxide from the air and delivering oxygen. We can save our environment from the greenhouse effect by reducing the emission of carbon dioxide.  অনুবাদ(Passage No. 2) : See NKM High School and Homes, Narsingdi. Sl. No. 18; Page No. 65
